question: How many years has Narendra Modi completed as the Prime Minister of India as of May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eleven years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narendra Modi** became the **Prime Minister of India** on **May 26, 2014**, after leading the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) to a landslide victory in the general elections.
 
• By **May 2025**, Narendra Modi will have completed a total of **eleven years** as the Prime Minister of India.
 
• His first term spanned from **May 2014 to May 2019**, followed by his second term which began in **May 2019**.
 
• During his tenure, Narendra Modi has implemented various landmark policies and schemes such as **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan**, **Ayushman Bharat**, and **Digital India**, which have had a significant impact on the country's socio-economic landscape.
 
• **May 2025** marks the completion of **11 years** since Narendra Modi assumed office as Prime Minister of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Timeline of Narendra Modi's Political Journey:**

 
 
• Before becoming Prime Minister, Narendra Modi served as the **Chief Minister of Gujarat** from **October 2001 to May 2014**.
 
• He led the BJP to a historic victory in the **2014 General Elections**, securing a majority with **282 seats** in the Lok Sabha.
 
• In **2019 General Elections**, under his leadership, BJP won **303 seats**, further solidifying his position as India's Prime Minister.
 
 
 
• **Key Policies Introduced During His Tenure:**
 
 
• **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan:** Launched in **2014**, this campaign aimed to eliminate open defecation and improve solid waste management across India.
 
• **Ayushman Bharat:** Introduced in **2018**, it is the world's largest government-funded healthcare program, providing health coverage to over **10 crore families**.
 
• **Digital India:** Initiated in **2015**, it aims to transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy.
 
• **Make in India:** Launched in **2014**, this initiative aimed to encourage companies to manufacture their products in India and boost domestic production.
 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat:** This program, initiated during the COVID-19 pandemic, focuses on self-reliance and boosting the domestic economy.
 
 
 
• **Election Victories:**
 
 
• In **2014**, Narendra Modi led BJP to its first majority win in **30 years**, marking a significant shift in Indian politics.
 
• In **2019**, his leadership saw BJP surpass its previous record, securing **303 seats** and forming a strong government.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Leadership:**
 
 
• Under Modi’s leadership, India has seen significant reforms in areas like **infrastructure**, **economy**, and **foreign policy**.
 
• His government has focused on the themes of **development**, **nationalism**, and **poverty alleviation**.
 
• He has strengthened India's global position through active diplomacy and participation in international forums like the **G20**, **BRICS**, and **Quad**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Prime Minister’s Designation:** The **Prime Minister of India** is the head of the government and is appointed by the **President of India**. The tenure is typically **five years**, but can be extended if re-elected.
 
• **Tenure Calculation:** Narendra Modi’s tenure is calculated from **May 26, 2014**, the day he took oath as the Prime Minister, to **May 2025**, marking the completion of **11 years**.
 
• **Key Achievements:** His tenure has been marked by a focus on **economic reforms**, **technological development**, and **social welfare schemes**.
 
• **Global Recognition:** Narendra Modi has been recognized internationally for his leadership and policies, receiving awards like the **Champions of the Earth Award** from the **United Nations**.
